_doc: Imported whole from fallout-universe-map.kml, folder 'Pre-Great War countries'. Already WGS84 - this source needs no registration, which is why it outranks every fitted sheet here. `canon` records how a feature should be treated, NOT whether it was imported: everything is imported.
label: Pre-war countries
creator: u/Sparky_321, extending u/MarcelusWalrus

properties.name: People's Republic of China
properties.note: The People's Republic of China was a pre-war communist nation in Asia. By the mid 21st century, they had largely annexed several smaller neighboring nations.

properties.name: Taiwan
properties.note: Taiwan was a pre-war country in Asia. It was hostile to its neighbor, the People's Republic of China, who expressed their desire to annex them for well over a century. The Taiwan Strait was briefly destabilized during the Pascale Incident, but covert American intervention deterred any further action.

properties.name: Israel
properties.note: Israel was a pre-war nation in the Middle East region. In 2053, terrorists detonated a nuke in Tel Aviv.

properties.name: The Congo
properties.note: The Congo was a pre-war nation in Africa. **References to the Congo do not specify which nation, meaning that they likely unified into one at some point.**

properties.name: India
properties.note: India was a pre-war country in Asia.

properties.name: Vietnam
properties.note: Vietnam was a pre-war country divided into northern and southern halves, which were communist and non-communist, respectively. The United States briefly intervened on the side of the south in the mid 20th century, but the conflict was subdued and did not escalate into a full-blown war. **Tactics shows the US formally declaring war on Vietnam, but other sources have stated that the full-scale war in our world did not occur.**

properties.name: Philippines
properties.note: The Philippines was a pre-war country in Southeast Asia. During the Sino-American War, American troops occupied the island of Camiguin to protect against any potential Chinese invasion.

properties.name: Slovakia
properties.note: ** Czechoslovakia likely dissolved into the Czech Republic and Slovakia, just as it did in our world, as implied by the appearance of the Czech coat of arms. **

properties.name: Argentina
properties.note: Argentina was a pre-war country located in South America.

properties.name: Mongolia
properties.note: Monglia was a pre-war country in Asia. By 2077, it was largely annexed by China.

properties.name: Czechia
properties.note: ** Czechoslovakia likely dissolved into the Czech Republic and Slovakia, just as it did in our world, as implied by the appearance of the Czech coat of arms. **

properties.name: Germany
properties.note: **As the fall of communism in Europe is implied via references to the dissolution of Czechoslovakia, it is likely that Germany unified, just as it did in our world.**

properties.name: Arabia
properties.note: Arabia was a pre-war nation. ** The country is referred to as "Arabia" by the Sole Survivor in Fallout 4 when speaking with Jack Cabot, meaning that by 2077, it was no longer ruled by the Saudi family. **
